segments.sn5.4:1.2: Atha kho vijayā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā … pe … aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn5.4:1.4: Atha kho māro pāpimā vijayāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo samādhimhā cāvetukāmo yena vijayā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā vijayaṃ bhikkhuniṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn5.4:3.2: “ko nu khvāyaṃ manusso vā amanusso vā gāthaṃ bhāsatī”ti?
segments.sn5.4:3.4: “māro kho ayaṃ pāpimā mama bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo samādhimhā cāvetukāmo gāthaṃ bhāsatī”ti.
segments.sn5.4:3.5: Atha kho vijayā bhikkhunī “māro ayaṃ pāpimā” iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi –
segments.sn5.4:4.1: “Rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā;
segments.sn5.4:6.1: “Ye ca rūpūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino [āruppaṭṭhāyino (sī. pī.)];
segments.sn5.4:6.3: Yā ca santā samāpatti, sabbattha vihato tamo”ti.
segments.sn5.4:7.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ vijayā bhikkhunī”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Catutthe pañcaṅgikenāti ātataṃ vitataṃ ātatavitataṃ ghanaṃ susiranti evaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgatena.
Pūtikāyenāti suvaṇṇavaṇṇopi kāyo niccaṃ uggharitapaggharitaṭṭhena pūtikāyova, tasmā evamāha.
Santā samāpattīti aṭṭhavidhā lokiyasamāpatti ārammaṇasantatāya aṅgasantatāya ca santāti vuttā.
Sabbatthāti sabbesu rūpārūpabhavesu, tesaṃ dvinnaṃ bhavānaṃ gahitattā gahite kāmabhave aṭṭhasu ca samāpattīsūti etesu sabbesu ṭhānesu mayhaṃ avijjātamo vihatoti vadati.
Pañca aṅgāni etassāti pañcaṅgaṃ, pañcaṅgameva pañcaṅgikaṃ, tena pañcaṅgikena.
Cammapariyonaddhaṃ sesaṃ tantibaddhaṃ sabbaṃ ātatavitataṃ nāma, gomukhīādīnampi ettheva saṅgaho daṭṭhabbo.
Tattha sammatāḷaṃ nāma daṇḍamayatāḷaṃ, kaṃsamayatāḷaṃ kaṃsatāḷaṃ, silāyaṃ ayopattena ca tāḷanatāḷaṃ.
